text: This capstone's warehouse is a star schema: one fact table at the center, surrounded by four dimensions, built entirely from real AdventureWorks2012 tables.
Before a single column gets named, the grain is fixed: one row per order line, matching Sales.SalesOrderDetail exactly. Every column added to the fact table from here on has to be true at that grain.

In the raw source data, a product's category sits two joins away, through ProductSubcategory and ProductCategory. This warehouse resolves that join exactly once, during the load, and flattens the result directly onto dw.DimProduct — so every front-end gets one simple table instead of re-running the join itself.
Next lesson writes the real CREATE TABLE statement for dw.FactProductSales — and explains why its foreign-key constraints have to wait until the dimensions exist.
